data.one_liner: Parse and encode TOML configuration files in Dart.
data.what_it_does: Provides a TOML v1.1.0 parser that converts TOML documents to Dart maps and an encoder that converts maps back to TOML strings. Supports loading files from assets, HTTP, or local file system.
use_when: You need to read or write TOML configuration files in a Dart or Flutter app.
You require a pure‑Dart solution without native dependencies.
avoid_when: You need a JSON‑or‑YAML‑only format or require schema validation.
Performance‑critical parsing of extremely large files is needed.
strengths: Full TOML 1.1 support including inline tables and new escape sequences
Works on all Dart platforms (mobile, web, desktop)
No native code, easy to add as a dependency
weaknesses: Only supports TOML; no other config formats
Encoder does not produce inline tables or dotted keys

alternatives.name: yaml
alternatives.why_pick_it: If your configuration is in YAML instead of TOML, the yaml package provides similar parsing capabilities.
